title: OFM orbitals.json
description: Array of orbital bodies for a star/system world. Used by the Coriolis-style space maps to compute positions over time and render planets, asteroids, starbases, etc.

id.description: Stable slug for cross-references; conventionally snake_case.

class.description: Body class. Conventional values: planet (terrestrial), J (Jovian), M (M-class), Y (Y-class), S (S-class), C (C-class), D (D-class), G (G-class), asteroids (belt), starbase (station). Casing matters — 'planet' and 'Planet' both occur in the wild.

centralMass.description: Mass of the parent body in kilograms (used for Keplerian solve).

longitudeOfAscendingNode.description: Longitude of ascending node in degrees.

periapses.description: Cached periapsis-passage epochs in Unix-ms; renderer interpolates between them.

ephemeris.description: Hints for the renderer about how the body's position is computed.

revolutionOrder.description: Axis around which the body revolves in the renderer's local frame. Almost always 'y'.

maps.description: Texture maps assigned to slots on the body.

slot.description: Which material slot this texture binds to. 'map' is the diffuse colour map.

url.description: Relative or absolute URL of the texture image.

textures.description: Legacy list of additional texture URLs (use `maps` for new entries).

satellites.description: Nested orbital bodies (moons, stations) — same schema recursively.
